info.title: Urja Meter API
info.description: A clean, read-only JSON API in front of the legacy "Urja Meter Ops" portal. Most data is fetched from the portal on request (`source: portal`, with `fetched_at`). Filtered meter lists, near-location queries and sync status come from a local SQLite index filled by `npm run sync` (`source: index`, with `synced_at`) and can be stale. Assumptions: portal timestamps are IST (+05:30); energy registers are kWh / kVAh. This API has no authentication of its own; run it on a trusted network.

get.description: Always HTTP 200 while this service is up. Makes one cheap read-only call to the portal, so it reports portal reachability (status degraded when the portal is not).

Without filters: live from the portal search, the source of truth for the meter list (`source: portal`); limit/offset are mapped onto the portal's 20-row pages. With any of make, phaseType, installStatus, installType, build, dtCode, zone or feeder: answered from the local SQLite index (`source: index`, see `synced_at`), combinable with `q`, and requires `npm run sync` to have run. `q` is a partial match on meter ID or serial number in both modes.

get.description: Per IST day: last register reading of the day minus the previous day's. The first reading is at 23:30, so the first day only anchors the next one and about 7 totals result. Days with a gap, an early end, or a register that went backwards (reset or meter swap) are left out and counted in skippedDays.
